cases.sentence: Мое учение польется, словно ___, пусть сойдут мои слова, как роса.
cases.translation: My teaching will drop as the rain; let my words descend as dew.
cases.explain: The verb льется (falls/pours down) takes the accusative case for its object.

cases.translation: I will proclaim the name of the Lord.
cases.explain: The noun имя (name) in the construction 'the name of someone' takes the genitive case.

cases.translation: God is faithful, he who does no wrong.
cases.explain: Бог is the subject of the predicate верен (faithful), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Не бойтесь его, ибо вы его сыновья, как ваш ___ творец.
cases.translation: Do not fear him, because you are his children, as your father, creator.
cases.explain: The possessive construction 'your father/creator' uses the genitive case in Russian apposition.

cases.sentence: Вспомни древние дни, подумай об ушедших ___.
cases.translation: Remember the days of old, consider the generations of long ago.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governing a prepositional phrase takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: He found him in a desert land.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Как орел вызывает свое гнездо и парит над своими ___.
cases.translation: As an eagle stirs up its nest and hovers over its young.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above/over) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Где же их боги, та ___, за которой они укрывались?
cases.translation: Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge?
cases.explain: Скала is the subject of the implied verb to be, so it stands in the nominative case.

reading.ru: Внимайте, небеса, я буду говорить, слушай, земля, слова моих уст.
reading.question: Who is being addressed to listen and hear God's words?
reading.explain: The opening verse directly addresses 'Внимайте, небеса... слушай, земля' — Give ear, heavens... listen, earth.

reading.ru: Он — скала, Его дела совершенны, все Его пути праведны.
reading.question: What characteristic of God's works and paths is emphasized?
reading.explain: The verse states 'Его дела совершенны, все Его пути праведны' — His works are perfect, all his ways are just.

reading.ru: В пустынной земле он его нашел, в степи печальной и дикой, ограждал его, пекся о нем, хранил его, как зеницу своего ока.
reading.question: How did God care for his people in the wilderness?
options: He found them in a barren land and guarded them as the apple of his eye
He abandoned them to fend for themselves
He tested them with hardship alone
reading.correct: He found them in a barren land and guarded them as the apple of his eye
reading.explain: The text describes how God 'хранил его, как зеницу своего ока' — kept him as the apple of his eye.

reading.ru: Ешурун растолстел и стал упрям, растолстел, обрюзг, разжирел, оставил Бога, который создал его.
reading.question: What did Jeshurun do after becoming fat and prosperous?
options: He abandoned God who made him
He thanked God for his blessing
reading.correct: He abandoned God who made him
reading.explain: The verse explicitly states 'оставил Бога, который создал его' — He abandoned God who created him.

reading.ru: Примите к сердцу все слова, которые я торжественно возвестил вам сегодня, чтобы вы велели своим детям прилежно слушаться всех слов этого закона.
reading.question: What does Moses urge the people to do with his words?
options: Take them to heart and instruct their children to obey the law
reading.correct: Take them to heart and instruct their children to obey the law
reading.explain: Moses commands 'Примите к сердцу все слова' and urges them to command their children to obey the law.

reading.ru: Поднимись на горную цепь Аварим, на гору Нева в Мааве, напротив Иерихона, и осмотри Ханаан, землю, которую я отдаю во владение израилетянам.
reading.question: What is Moses commanded to do on Mount Nebo?
options: Ascend the mountain, view the land of Canaan that God is giving to the Israelites
Lead the people across the Jordan River
reading.correct: Ascend the mountain, view the land of Canaan that God is giving to the Israelites
reading.explain: God commands Moses to 'Поднимись на горную цепь Аварим... и осмотри Ханаан, землю, которую я отдаю' — go up and view the land.
